purpose: Separate BRTI directional-pricing calibration from maker execution/completion performance.
hard_guards: Reject every explicitly supplied path containing 2026-07-23 or date=2026-07-23.
Never glob, enumerate, open, or hash a 2026-07-23 orderbook or CF capture path.
After parsing, reject any selected market close date or BRTI source date outside 2026-07-20..22.

Reconstruct books only by snapshot reset followed by ordered deltas. Any negative displayed quantity, unknown side/update semantics, or per-market sequence regression invalidates that entire market-day for market-mid and gap analyses; never clamp a negative level to zero.
Do not substitute Coinbase, another index, later 2026-07-25..26 BRTI capture, market mid, or terminal settlement for the missing historical BRTI path.
If source-time alignment cannot be established, emit NO_DECISION_DATA_ALIGNMENT_BLOCKED and no pricing verdict.

kernel.implementation: Exact arithmetic embedded from tools/research/crypto_mm/rti_pricing.py and current mm_engine pricing_state contract.

analysis_1_calibration.sampling: One row per settled market at each fixed TTE in {120,180,240}s; latest valid BRTI tick at or before target, age <=2s; latest causally reconstructed two-sided book at the same source time.
analysis_1_calibration.outcome: Official market result YES=1/NO=0; CF final-minute average is a consistency check only when available.

forecasts.market: (best YES bid + implied YES ask from best NO bid)/2

metrics: logistic calibration intercept a and slope b in logit(P(Y=1))=a+b*logit(forecast)
paired kernel-minus-market Brier and log-loss differences
analysis_1_calibration.uncertainty: Market-cluster bootstrap, 2000 replicates, seed 26072601, percentile 95% CI.
analysis_1_calibration.minimum_reportable: At least 20 unique settled markets and both outcomes; otherwise descriptive only.

analysis_2_gap_lead.sampling: Every fifth authoritative BRTI source second in 120<=TTE<300 with valid fair and two-sided causal book.
analysis_2_gap_lead.gap: kernel fair probability minus market YES mid, in percentage points
analysis_2_gap_lead.future_change: Causal book mid at t+h minus mid at t, percentage points; persistent book state is LOCF, never a future-before-target observation.
statistics: OLS slope with intercept of future mid change on gap
directional hit rate excluding zero gap or zero future move
analysis_2_gap_lead.uncertainty: Market-cluster bootstrap, 2000 replicates, seed 26072602, percentile 95% CI; report every fixed horizon without selecting the best.

book_replay_validity.snapshot: Replace both YES and NO maps from the complete snapshot.
book_replay_validity.delta: Add signed delta_e4 to the exact side/price level.
book_replay_validity.valid_level: Displayed quantity must remain >=0 at every update; best bid uses only strictly positive displayed quantity.
book_replay_validity.failure_scope: Any negative level, sequence regression, missing initial snapshot, or unknown side invalidates that market-day for all mid-based analyses.
book_replay_validity.degradation: Kernel-versus-outcome calibration may continue without a market-mid benchmark; market baseline, fair-mid gap lead tests, and L2 completion-cost paths must report BLOCKED_BOOK_REPLAY_INVALID.

analysis_3_p3_link.pnl_eligibility: Requires per-episode market, first-fill source timestamp, and realized PnL, source-time aligned to BRTI and reconstructed book without lookahead.
analysis_3_p3_link.completion_cost_eligibility: Additionally requires first-fill side and price plus a valid exact L2 path; missing side blocks the completion-cost target but does not by itself block the PnL target.
targets: realized first-fill episode PnL in cents
opposite-leg executable ask deterioration from fill time to +10s in cents, if first side and exact L2 path are present
analysis_3_p3_link.model: Fixed ridge linear model lambda=1.0; train-only median/IQR scaling; deterministic five folds by SHA256(market) modulo five; all rows for one market remain in one fold.
analysis_3_p3_link.minimum_reportable: At least 20 aligned episodes and 10 unique markets; otherwise NO_DECISION for P3 linkage.
analysis_3_p3_link.head_subset: Top 20% by market-grouped OOF predicted episode PnL; report actual mean PnL, n, markets, and market-cluster bootstrap 95% CI. Also report difference versus all eligible episodes.
analysis_3_p3_link.anti_leakage: No settlement outcome, future book state, completion label, or realized PnL enters features.

interpretation.calibration_layer: Tests whether the BRTI kernel assigns direction probabilities better than the contemporaneous market.
interpretation.execution_layer: Tests whether first-leg fills complete economically; queue, adverse selection, fees, and forced exits live here.
interpretation.decision_rule: Never infer kernel correctness from MM PnL alone and never infer execution viability from calibration alone.
interpretation.discovery_only: No result from these dates authorizes deployment or parameter changes.

required_blocker_detail: which required source-time fields are absent
earliest known capture date if discoverable without opening the banned date
